advice: Abstain. The supplied evidence does not establish a distinct cache-blocking change worth proposing. The 16-call panel32 path has already been measured without a repeatable gain, and the full512 kernel already uses the 64×32 traversal. A different packing and traversal design would combine several changes, with no evidence here to isolate or support a cache hypothesis.
risks: No new experiment is proposed. Existing scores do not identify a bottleneck, and none exceeds 1800 GFLOP/s. Do not treat prior noisy results as evidence of cache causality.
